name: route_specific_history_vs_period
decision_rationale: At fixed four-month training length, route-specific loses on May-Jun and Jul-Aug but wins on Sep-Oct. For the same Sep-Oct target, it wins with 4, 6, and 8 months of history, so training length changes magnitude but not the sign. Route 17 and 50 account for much of the four-month Sep-Oct gain; their target-level shifts are descriptive associations, not established causes.
next_minimal_experiment: Decompose the fixed May-Aug to Sep-Oct predictions by September vs October and by route without changing training, features, or parameters.
